## About
Kevin McMullen Racing is an off-road shop in Peoria that grew out of racing. We work on off-road transmissions, performance suspensions and custom chassis, and we manufacture long travel sand cars from start to finish.
Kevin also races with the Kevin McMullen Racing Team, so the parts and setups we work on get tested out in the desert, not just in the shop.
Whether you need a full race prep or a minor repair, we are glad to talk it through. Our customers have given us a 5 star rating across 24 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transaxle work: One reviewer said Kevin rebuilt their transaxle.
- Shock and suspension tuning: Fine tuning of suspension and shock components.
- Fabrication and race prep: Fabrication work from complete race prep to minor repairs.
- Long travel sand car manufacturing: Start to finish manufacturing of long travel sand cars.
- Quad arm manufacturing: We manufacture quad arms.
- Magnaflux service: A complete magnaflux service.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on sand cars?
A: Yes. We do full prep on off-road race cars and sand cars.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

## What customers say
- "First time customer and super impressed with the whole experience. Kevin spent ample time on the phone answering my questions, issues & fixes for my sand rail (first-time sand car owner) before I even stepped foot in the shop. He was patient, relaxed, knowledgeable, and most-importantly willing to share his knowledge.
He revalved and refreshed my King bypasses, reservoir coilovers, and bumpstops. Also rebuilt my transaxle (Mendeola 2D).  He set time-frame & cost estimate expectations and followed through on both.  Another thing, my rod ends (hiems) were an oddball size (1"-12tpi) that I couldn't find anywhere.  Kevin was able to track down 1 of 2 companies in the U.S. that still make them. The alternative would have been much more costly (chop up arms and reweld new standard threaded bungs).
Lastly, I was having a tough time stabbing (aligning) the transaxle back into the motor, so Kevin stopped by on his way home to give me a hand. Way above and beyond! I rarely find businesses that take such good care of customers from start to finish, so I'm thankful to have found Kevin at Kevin McMullen Racing." (Josh, 5/5)
- "Brought failed Fox shocks from Munds Park to Phoenix in hopes of getting them rebuilt on a turn-around-trip. I though customer service like this was long dead, but McMullen & Team proves how wrong that is.  Kudos to them; they have my highest recommendation!" (Randy Ocheltree, 5/5)
